title: 先把门槛对一遍：十二条路的年龄和学历要求都是明文写死的
englishTitle: First, check the eligibility criteria: the age and education requirements for all twelve pathways are clearly stated in official documents.
originalText:
### 1. 先把门槛对一遍：十二条路的年龄和学历要求都是明文写死的
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=中 口径=时间 -->
- 成本：不花钱。花十分钟对一遍，看自己够不够得着。
- 说人话：这十二条路的年龄和学历门槛，都明文写在文件里。打工要满 16 周岁。当兵是男性满 18 周岁，本科毕业生可以放宽到 24 周岁。考公务员要 18 到 35 周岁、大专以上学历。自考和办个体户这两条，既不看学历，也不看年龄。
- 收益：当兵看兵役法：「年满十八周岁的男性公民，应当被征集服现役；当年未被征集的，在二十二周岁以前仍可以被征集服现役。普通高等学校毕业生的征集年龄可以放宽至二十四周岁，研究生的征集年龄可以放宽至二十六周岁」。考公务员看《公务员录用规定》第十八条。报考条件含「年龄为十八周岁以上，三十五周岁以下」「具有大学专科以上文化程度」。这两项经省级以上公务员主管部门批准可适当调整。该规定第十九条列了五类不得报考的人。比如因犯罪受过刑事处罚的、被开除公职的、被列为失信联合惩戒对象的。消防员看《国家综合性消防救援队伍消防员招录办法》。第五条「年龄为 18 周岁以上、22 周岁以下」「具有高中以上文化程度」。第六条「大学专科以上学历人员、解放军和武警部队退役士兵……年龄可以放宽至 24 周岁」。军队文职看《中国人民解放军文职人员条例》第九条，基本条件含「年满 18 周岁」。该条例第十九条写明，较低职级岗位首次招录聘用最高年龄 35 周岁。较低职级岗位就是入门层级的岗位。事业单位看《事业单位人事管理条例》第八条「事业单位新聘用工作人员，应当面向社会公开招聘」。个体户看《促进个体工商户发展条例》「有经营能力的公民……依法登记为个体工商户的，适用本条例」。自考看《高等教育自学考试暂行条例》。第三条「中华人民共和国公民，不受性别、年龄、民族、种族和已受教育程度的限制，均可依照本条例的规定参加高等教育自学考试」。第二十条「各级各类全日制学校的在校生不得报考」。公费师范生看《教育部直属师范大学本研衔接师范生公费教育实施办法》第二条。它只在六所部属师范大学招。分别是北京师范大学、华东师范大学、东北师范大学、华中师范大学、陕西师范大学和西南大学。本科和研究生阶段一体设计、分段考核，本科读完接着读研究生。在校期间的学费和住宿费由中央财政承担，另外还给生活费补助。该办法第五条「招收公费师范生实行提前批次录取」，就是在普通批次之前先录。定向医学生看《关于做好农村订单定向免费培养医学生就业安置和履约管理工作的通知》。它写着：「在录取后、获得入学通知书前，须与培养学校和定向就业所在地的县级卫生健康行政部门……人力资源社会保障部门签署协议」。出国打工看《对外劳务合作管理条例》。第五条：从事对外劳务合作应当经商务主管部门批准取得经营资格。第七条第四款：「未依法取得对外劳务合作经营资格证书并办理登记，不得从事对外劳务合作」。没有这张资格证的公司组织人出国打工，本身就违法。第八条第二款：「任何单位和个人不得以商务、旅游、留学等名义组织劳务人员赴国外工作」。平台接单和灵活就业没有法定学历门槛，自己参保和职业伤害保障的依据见本节第 11、12 条。打工看义务教育法：「禁止用人单位招用应当接受义务教育的适龄儿童、少年」。《禁止使用童工规定》第二条写明不得招用不满 16 周岁的人，罚则见第 23 节第 1 条（不满 16 周岁）。
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：全国人大常委会 (2021). 兵役法（第二十条）. <http://www.mod.gov.cn/regulatory/2021-08/20/content_4892491.htm>（国防部刊登）；中共中央组织部 (2019). 公务员录用规定（第十八、十九条）. <https://www.12371.cn/2020/01/08/ARTI1578447606460158.shtml>（共产党员网刊登）；人力资源社会保障部、应急管理部 (2021). 国家综合性消防救援队伍消防员招录办法（人社部发〔2021〕58 号，第五、六条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-08/27/content_5633684.htm>；国务院、中央军委 (2022). 中国人民解放军文职人员条例（第二次修订，令第 757 号，第九、十九条）. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181857bca5e01859ee5a6c06d62>（国家法律法规数据库）；国务院 (2014). 事业单位人事管理条例（国务院令第 652 号，第八条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2014-05/15/content_8810.htm>；国务院 (2022). 促进个体工商户发展条例（国务院令第 755 号，第二条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-10/25/content_5721592.htm>；国务院 (1988, 2014 修订). 高等教育自学考试暂行条例（第三、二十条）. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f3cbb3c016f415d64e5236d>（国家法律法规数据库）；全国人大常委会 (2018). 义务教育法（第十四条）. <http://www.moe.gov.cn/jyb_sjzl/sjzl_zcfg/zcfg_jyfl/202110/t20211029_575949.html>（教育部刊登）；国务院 (2002). 禁止使用童工规定（国务院令第 364 号，第二条）. <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2002/content_61798.htm>；国务院办公厅 (2024). 关于转发教育部等部门《教育部直属师范大学本研衔接师范生公费教育实施办法》的通知（国办发〔2024〕27 号，第二、五条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202406/content_6957261.htm>；国家卫生健康委等 7 部门 (2019). 关于做好农村订单定向免费培养医学生就业安置和履约管理工作的通知. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-11/13/content_5451684.htm>；国务院 (2012). 对外劳务合作管理条例（国务院令第 620 号，第五、七、八条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2012-06/11/content_1091.htm>
- 备注：够得着门槛之后，还要过政治条件、体检和政治考核这几关。这几关没有公开的打分标准，条文里查不到。中职、技工院校和职教贯通招生的入口见第 23 节第 5 条，家里供不起时的资助见第 23 节第 4 条。个体户不看学历，但开店并不容易。本钱、个人担保和关门退场的成本见第 12 节。个人担保的意思是公司还不上，就得你自己还。起步钱能不能借到国家替你出一部分利息的贷款，见本节第 16 条。公费师范生和定向医学生这两条，在高考填志愿那天就定下了，代价写在第 13 条。出国打工的门槛不在你身上，在公司有没有资质上，怎么认见第 14 条。哪条路更划算，这里不作比较。

### 1. First, check the eligibility criteria: the age and education requirements for all twelve pathways are clearly stated in official documents.
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=Low Willpower=No Benefit=Med Metric=Time -->
- Cost: No cost at all. It only takes ten minutes to review whether you meet the criteria.
- In plain terms: The age and education requirements for all twelve pathways are explicitly listed in official documents. You must be at least 16 years old to work. For military service, men must be 18 years old; university graduates may be eligible up to age 24. To become a civil servant, you must be between 18 and 35 years old with at least an associate degree. The self-study exam and self-employment pathways have no age or education restrictions.
- Benefit: Military service rules state: “All male citizens who reach 18 years of age must be drafted into active service; those not drafted that year may still be drafted up to age 22. University graduates may be eligible up to age 24, and postgraduate students up to age 26.” Civil service requirements are outlined in Article 18 of the Civil Servant Recruitment Regulations, which specify ages between 18 and 35 and at least an associate degree; these limits may be adjusted with approval from provincial-level authorities. Article 19 lists disqualifying factors such as criminal convictions, dismissal from public office, or inclusion in credit blacklists. Firefighter recruitment follows similar age and education criteria. Civilian roles in the military require a minimum age of 18, with upper limits of 35 for entry-level positions. Public institution hiring must be conducted openly, while self-employment is open to any capable adult. Self-study exams are accessible to all citizens regardless of background, though full-time students are excluded. Government-funded teacher and medical training programs are offered at select universities, with tuition and living expenses covered; these commitments must be honored as outlined in their respective regulations. Overseas employment requires companies to hold proper government authorization; otherwise such arrangements are illegal.
- Evidence grade: A

Meeting these criteria is only the first step; additional requirements include political background checks, physical fitness tests, and other evaluations with no publicly available scoring metrics. Details on vocational education options and financial aid are provided in later sections. Starting a business requires capital, personal guarantees, and carries financial risks. Student loans with government-backed interest subsidies may be available. Commitments made during college admissions for teacher and medical training programs have specific obligations. Legal compliance for overseas employment depends on employer qualifications.

title: 十八岁那年 10 月 31 日前要做兵役登记；义务兵服现役就是两年
englishTitle: Men who turn 18 must complete military service registration by October 31; mandatory active duty lasts two years.
originalText:
### 2. 十八岁那年 10 月 31 日前要做兵役登记；义务兵服现役就是两年
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=多 毅力=是 收益=中 口径=时间 -->
- 成本：不花钱。登记在网上填一次，几分钟就填完。真去当兵，代价是两年全职，这两年里没法同时干别的。
- 说人话：兵役登记是法定义务，不是报名参军，登记了也不等于要去。当年满 18 周岁的男性，要在 10 月 31 日前上网登记完。不登记的，县里会责令你限期改正，还不改就强制你履行兵役义务并罚款。真去当兵，义务兵服现役就是两年。
- 收益：登记看《兵役登记工作规定》。它写着：「县、自治县、不设区的市、市辖区人民政府兵役机关应当于每年 10 月 31 日前，组织本行政区域内当年 12 月 31 日以前年满 18 周岁的男性公民进行初次兵役登记」。同一份规定还写着：「初次兵役登记主要采取网络登记的方式进行，由公民通过兵役登记网络平台自主完成」。不登记会怎么样，看兵役法第五十七条第一款。这一款管的是「拒绝、逃避兵役登记的」。处罚是「由县级人民政府责令限期改正；逾期不改正的，由县级人民政府强制其履行兵役义务，并处以罚款」。兵役法还写着「义务兵服现役的期限为二年」。「根据军队需要和本人自愿，可以征集年满十七周岁未满十八周岁的公民服现役」。军士「服现役满十二年或者符合国家规定的其他条件的，由安置地的县级以上地方人民政府安排工作」。军士「服现役满三十年或者年满五十五周岁或者符合国家规定的其他条件的，作退休安置」。安排工作就是由政府给一份工作，退休安置就是按退休办退下来。《征兵工作条例》写着「优先保证普通高等学校毕业生和对政治、身体条件或者专业技能有特别要求的兵员征集」。该条例还写着「应征公民为普通高等学校的全日制在校生、应届毕业生的，可以在入学前户籍所在地或者学校所在地应征」（全国）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：国务院办公厅、中央军委办公厅 (2025). 兵役登记工作规定（国办发〔2025〕41 号）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202512/content_7051363.htm>；全国人大常委会 (2021). 兵役法（2021 年修订，第二十、二十五、二十六、五十四、五十七条）. <http://www.mod.gov.cn/regulatory/2021-08/20/content_4892491.htm>（国防部刊登）；国务院、中央军委 (2023). 征兵工作条例（国务院、中央军委令第 759 号，第五条）. <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2023/content_5753313.htm>
- 备注：登记和应征是两件事，代价差一大截。两年内不准出境那一串惩戒，只罚应征之后反悔的人，见第 3 条（拒服兵役）。女性不强制做初次兵役登记，按军队需要征集。士兵考军校、表现好的士兵转为军官（提干），条件都写在军队内部法规里，外面查不到。兵役法只写了两句：现役军官从「表现优秀的现役士兵」等人员中选拔招收，军队院校招学员不受征集年龄限制。具体分数线和名额本书不给。

### 2. Men who turn 18 must complete military service registration by October 31; mandatory active duty lasts two years.
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=High Willpower=Yes Benefit=Med Metric=Time -->

- Cost: There is no cost. The online registration takes just a few minutes. However, actual enlistment means two full years of service, during which you cannot hold any other job.

- In plain terms: Military service registration is a legal obligation, not an application to join the army. Completing it does not mean you must enlist. All men who turn 18 must register online by October 31. Failure to do so can result in a government order to register within a set period; if ignored, you may be forced into service and fined. Once enlisted, you serve as a conscript for exactly two years.

Consequences of non‑compliance are outlined in Article 57, Paragraph 1 of the Military Service Law, which addresses “refusal or evasion of registration.” Penalties include a deadline set by the county government for compliance, followed by forced enlistment and a fine if still ignored. The same law also states that “the term of active duty for conscripts is two years.” It further notes that men aged 17–18 may enlist voluntarily if the army needs them. Non‑commissioned officers who serve 12 years or meet other criteria are offered civilian jobs by local governments upon discharge; those serving 30 years or reaching age 55 may retire. ### 3. 应征之后拒服兵役，两年内不准出境或升学复学，还进不了公务员和国企
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- 成本：不花钱。代价是在报名之前，就要把去不去想清楚。
- 说人话：报了名又拒绝去当兵，后果是一串。公务员不能录用你，国有企业和事业单位也不能招你。两年内不准出境，不准升学，不准回学校复学。还会被列进履行国防义务严重失信主体名单。所以「先报上再说，不行就退回来」是个很贵的想法。
- 收益：兵役法第五十七条第一款第二项是「应征公民拒绝、逃避征集服现役的」。处罚同样是「由县级人民政府责令限期改正；逾期不改正的，由县级人民政府强制其履行兵役义务，并处以罚款」。同一条第二款：「有前款第二项行为，拒不改正的，不得录用为公务员或者参照《中华人民共和国公务员法》管理的工作人员，不得招录、聘用为国有企业和事业单位工作人员，两年内不准出境或者升学复学，纳入履行国防义务严重失信主体名单实施联合惩戒。」联合惩戒就是多个部门照同一份名单，一起执行上面这些限制。第五十八条把同一套惩戒接到已经入伍的人身上。军人以逃避服兵役为目的，拒绝履行职责或者逃离部队，后果要看处理结果。被军队除名、开除军籍或者被依法追究刑事责任的，依照第五十七条第二款处罚。其中被除名的并处罚款（全国，2021 年 10 月 1 日起施行）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：全国人大常委会 (2021). 兵役法（2021 年修订，第五十七、五十八条）. <http://www.mod.gov.cn/regulatory/2021-08/20/content_4892491.htm>（国防部刊登）
- 备注：这里算的是人身自由和就业资格，不是钱。这一串惩戒只罚两种人。一种是「应征公民拒绝、逃避征集服现役」的。另一种是入伍以后被除名、开除军籍、被追究刑责的。光是没做兵役登记的不在里面，兵役登记见第 2 条。罚的前提是「拒不改正」，由县级人民政府认定和处罚。罚多少钱各地自己定，本书不写。去不去由你自己定，但要在报名之前定下来。

### 3. Refusing military service after enlistment: no travel abroad, no further education, and barred from civil service and state-owned enterprises for two years
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=Low Willpower=No Benefit=High Metric=Freedom -->

- Cost: There is no monetary cost. The price is having to decide well in advance whether you want to serve or not.
- In plain terms: Choosing to enlist and then backing out carries serious consequences. You cannot be hired by any civil service office, nor by any state-owned enterprise or public institution. For two full years, you are prohibited from leaving the country, enrolling in any school, or returning to your studies. Your name will also be added to a list of individuals who have seriously failed to fulfill their national defense obligations, triggering coordinated penalties from multiple authorities. Therefore, the idea of “signing up first and then pulling out if needed” ends up being very costly.
- Benefit: Article 57, Paragraph 1, Item 2 of the Military Service Law explicitly states that “any conscript who refuses or evades enlistment shall be subject to penalties.” These penalties include a requirement to correct the behavior within a set timeframe; if they still refuse, the local county-level government may compel them to serve and impose a fine. Paragraph 2 adds that such individuals must also be barred from civil service roles, from employment in state-owned enterprises and public institutions, and from any travel abroad or further education for two years. They are placed on a special list of those who have failed to meet defense obligations, leading to joint enforcement actions by various agencies. Article 58 extends these same penalties to active-duty personnel who deliberately evade service or desert. Those who are discharged, expelled from the military, or face criminal prosecution are subject to the same restrictions outlined in Paragraph 2 of Article 57, including a nationwide fine effective as of October 1, 2021.
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2021). Military Service Law (Revised in 2021, Articles 57, 58). <http://www.mod.gov.cn/regulatory/2021-08/20/content_4892491.htm> (Published by the Ministry of National Defense)
- Notes: This rule concerns personal freedom and employment eligibility rather than financial penalties. Only two categories of people are subject to these measures: those who refuse or evade enlistment after being called up, and those who are discharged, expelled, or criminally prosecuted after already joining the armed forces. Individuals who simply fail to register for conscription are not included; registration details are covered in Item 2. The penalties apply only when the person refuses to comply after being instructed to do so, as determined by the local county-level government. The exact amount of any fine is set locally and is not specified in this guide. This information is provided solely to illustrate the irreversible nature of the decision once enlistment is initiated; it does not serve as encouragement or discouragement regarding military service.

title: 大学生当兵最实的两块：学费每年补最高 20000 元，学籍保留两年、考研有专项计划
englishTitle: Two main benefits for college students joining the military: up to 20,000 RMB per year for tuition, two-year extension of student status, and a special postgraduate admission program
originalText:
### 4. 大学生当兵最实的两块：学费每年补最高 20000 元，学籍保留两年、考研有专项计划
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：不花钱。退役以后按学校要求交材料申请，前后跑一两趟。
- 说人话：在校生、应届毕业生和新生去当兵，国家替你出读书那几年的学费，按实际交的补，本专科生每年最高 20000 元，研究生最高 25000 元。学费本来就低的，只补到实际交的那么多。学籍给你留两年。考研另有一条只招退役大学生士兵的专项计划。
- 收益：财政部等四部门 2024 年通知说，去服兵役的高校学生有三样待遇：学费补偿、用于学费的国家助学贷款代偿、学费减免。代偿就是国家替你把这笔助学贷款还掉。这三样的标准「相应调整为本专科学生每人每年最高不超过 20000 元、研究生每人每年最高不超过 25000 元」。新标准自 2024 年秋季学期起执行。到底按多少补，看这一句：「按学生实际缴纳的学费或获得的国家助学贷款（包括本金及其全部偿还之前产生的利息）两者金额较高者执行」。后面还有一句是「超出标准部分不予补偿、代偿或减免」。所以每年拿到的，是「实际学费和助学贷款里较高的那个」与上限两者中较小的那个。学费每年 5000 元的就补 5000 元。补几年按读书的年数算，不按服役的年数算。2019 年的学生资助资金管理办法写着：「入伍前已完成规定的修业年限，即为学费补偿或国家助学贷款代偿的年限；退役复学后接续完成规定的剩余修业年限，即为学费减免的年限」。应届毕业生去当兵，补的是整个学制的学费。学籍看《退役军人保障法》。它写着：「现役军人入伍前已被普通高等学校录取或者是正在普通高等学校就学的学生，服现役期间保留入学资格或者学籍，退役后两年内允许入学或者复学，可以按照国家有关规定转入本校其他专业学习」。该法还写着：「高等学校根据国家统筹安排，可以通过单列计划、单独招生等方式招考退役军人」。考研看教育部办公厅 2026 年通知。这个计划叫「退役大学生士兵计划」。通知写着：「在全国硕士研究生招生计划总规模内单列下达、专项使用，不得调整为普通计划或其他专项计划。招生单位自主确定……初试成绩要求（一般不高于本单位相应学科专业普通计划考生初试成绩要求）……同等条件下服役时间长的考生优先录取」。单列、专项使用的意思是，这部分名额单独划出来，只能用来招退役大学生士兵。这个计划 2026 年由 532 所普通高等学校承担（全国）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：财政部、教育部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局 (2024). 关于调整完善国家助学贷款有关政策的通知（财教〔2024〕188 号）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202411/content_6984812.htm>；财政部等五部门 (2019). 学生资助资金管理办法（财科教〔2019〕19 号，第五条；入伍资助年限：「入伍前已完成规定的修业年限，即为学费补偿或国家助学贷款代偿的年限；退役复学后接续完成规定的剩余修业年限，即为学费减免的年限」，毕业生「学费补偿或国家助学贷款代偿的年限，分别按照国家规定的相应学制计算」）. <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5421553.htm>；全国人大常委会 (2020). 退役军人保障法（第三十四、三十五条）. <http://www.mod.gov.cn/gfbw/fgwx/flfg/16048597.html>（国防部刊登）；教育部办公厅 (2025). 关于做好 2026 年退役大学生士兵专项硕士研究生招生计划招生工作的通知（教学厅〔2025〕8 号）. <http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A15/moe_778/s3261/202512/t20251211_1423174.html>；退役军人事务部 (2022). 退役士兵教育培训政策 23 条：「从2022年招生起，高职（专科）毕业生及在校生（含高校新生）应征入伍，退役后完成高职（专科）学业的，申请专升本，免于参加文化课考试」（依据教学厅〔2021〕8 号）. <https://www.mva.gov.cn/sy/xx/bnxx/202201/t20220107_55052.html>；教育部 (2026). 2027 年全国硕士研究生招生工作管理规定（教学〔2026〕2 号，第二十二、二十四、二十五条），研招网刊登. <https://yz.chsi.com.cn/kyzx/jybzc/202609/20260924/2293971511.html>；教育部 (2024). 2025 年全国硕士研究生招生工作管理规定（教学〔2024〕4 号，第二十二条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202410/content_6978684.htm>
- 备注：还有两条通道。一是专升本免考文化课：专科生去当兵，退役后读完专科，可以申请免试专升本，由学校考职业技能后择优录取。这条从 2022 年招生起执行，具体办法看本省当年的通知。二是考研初试加 10 分：退役大学生士兵退役后 3 年内考研，初试总分加 10 分。报了专项计划就不再加分，两样不能一起享受。立过二等功以上的，可以申请免初试读研。招专项计划的学校名单每年变，2025 年是 523 所。学费标准调过两次：2019 年是 8000/12000，2023 年秋改成 16000/20000，2024 年秋改成 20000/25000。退役军人事务部 2022 年的摘要里还是最早那一版，别照抄。

### 4. Two main benefits for college students joining the military: up to 20,000 RMB per year for tuition, two-year extension of student status, and a special postgraduate admission program
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=Low Willpower=No Benefit=High Metric=Money -->

- Cost: No out-of-pocket expense. After discharge, students must submit required documents to their school; this typically involves one or two visits.

- In plain terms: Undergraduate, graduate, and incoming freshmen who enlist receive tuition coverage from the state for the duration of their studies. The maximum annual amount is 20,000 RMB for undergraduates and 25,000 RMB for graduate students. Only the actual tuition paid is reimbursed. Student status is preserved for two years. Additionally, there is a dedicated postgraduate admission program exclusively for discharged college veterans.

- Benefit: In 2024, four government agencies including the Ministry of Finance announced three key benefits for eligible students: tuition reimbursement, repayment of national student loans, and tuition waivers. Repayment of loans means the state settles the outstanding balance on behalf of the student. The maximum annual limits are set at 20,000 RMB for undergraduates and 25,000 RMB for graduate students, effective from the autumn 2024 semester. The actual amount awarded equals the lower of either the actual tuition paid or the student loan balance. For instance, a student paying 5,000 RMB per year receives the full 5,000 RMB. The total coverage period matches the length of the original academic program, not the length of military service. According to the Law on Veterans’ Affairs, student status remains intact during service and for two years after discharge, allowing students to transfer to other majors if desired. Universities are also required to reserve spots for veterans through separate admission tracks. The “Special Postgraduate Program for Discharged College Veterans” guarantees dedicated slots at 532 universities nationwide, with admission criteria slightly relaxed compared to regular programs.

title: 退役后只有六种情况由政府安排工作；自主就业的 30 日内必须报到
englishTitle: Only six scenarios allow the government to assign jobs after discharge; those opting for self-employment must register within 30 days
originalText:
### 5. 退役后只有六种情况由政府安排工作；自主就业的 30 日内必须报到
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：不花钱。带上退役证明，到安置地的退役军人事务部门跑一趟。
- 说人话：「当兵包分配」早就不是普遍情况。现在只有六种情况由政府安排工作，义务兵服两年退役，绝大多数不在这六种里面。不由政府安排工作的那一档叫自主就业，它有个硬期限：退出现役之后 30 日内必须去报到。没有正当理由超过 30 日，就算你放弃安置待遇。
- 收益：《退役军人安置条例》第二十五条列了六种情形，由安置地人民政府安排工作。原文是：「（一）军士服现役满 12 年的；（二）服现役期间个人获得勋章、荣誉称号的；（三）服现役期间个人荣获三等战功、二等功以上奖励的；（四）服现役期间个人获得一级表彰的；（五）因战致残被评定为 5 级至 8 级残疾等级的；（六）是烈士子女的」。该条例还写着：「安置地人民政府应当在接收退役军士和义务兵的 6 个月内完成安排退役军士和义务兵工作的任务」。用人单位「应当按照规定与其签订不少于 3 年的中长期聘用合同或者劳动合同。其中，企业接收军龄 10 年以上的退役军士的，应当与其签订无固定期限劳动合同」。无固定期限就是合同上不写到期日。待安排工作期间「按照当地月最低工资标准逐月发放生活补助」。不是因为你自己的原因没按规定安排上岗的，「按照不低于本单位同等条件人员平均工资 80% 的标准，逐月发放生活费直至上岗为止」。不得以安排工作方式安置的情形，包括被开除中国共产党党籍、受过刑事处罚。自主就业的期限看第五十一条：「自主就业的退役军士和义务兵，应当自被批准退出现役之日起 30 日内，到安置地人民政府退役军人工作主管部门报到。无正当理由不按照规定时间报到超过 30 日的，视为放弃安置待遇。」（全国，2024 年 9 月 1 日起施行）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：国务院、中央军委 (2024). 退役军人安置条例（国务院、中央军委令第 787 号，2024 年 7 月 29 日公布、9 月 1 日施行；第二十五、三十一、三十二、三十五、五十一、七十五条）. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11526/202408/content_6969192.html>；全国人大常委会 (2020). 退役军人保障法（第十三、十四、十五条）. <http://www.mod.gov.cn/gfbw/fgwx/flfg/16048597.html>（国防部刊登）
- 备注：这份条例施行的同一天，2011 年的《退役士兵安置条例》（国务院、中央军委令第 608 号）废止。网上大量攻略引的还是旧条例，条件表述已经变了，旧版写的是「平时荣获二等功以上奖励或者战时荣获三等功以上奖励」。30 日这个期限只管自主就业那一档，其他安置方式是「按照规定时间」报到。报到时会发退役军人优待证，后面的退役金、就业创业扶持和教育资助都从这里接上。

### 5. Only six scenarios allow the government to assign jobs after discharge; those opting for self-employment must register within 30 days
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=Low Willpower=No Benefit=High Metric=Money -->
- Cost: No cost involved. Simply bring your discharge certificate and visit the local Civil Affairs Bureau for veterans.
- In plain terms: The notion that “the military guarantees job placement” no longer applies broadly. Currently, only six specific scenarios qualify for government job assignments. Most conscripts who serve two years do not fall into these categories. Those not eligible for government placement are considered self-employed, and they must register within 30 days of discharge. Failing to do so without valid reasons means they forfeit any entitlement to government assistance.
- Benefit: Article 25 of the Regulations on Placement of Veterans specifies six circumstances under which local governments must assign jobs. These include: (1) non-commissioned officers with at least 12 years of service; (2) personnel awarded medals or honorary titles during service; (3) those receiving third-class combat merits or higher; (4) individuals receiving first-class commendations; (5) those disabled at levels 5–8 due to combat; and (6) children of martyrs. The same regulations state that local governments must complete job placement within six months of receiving discharged personnel. Employers must sign medium- or long-term contracts lasting at least three years; for non-commissioned officers with ten-plus years of service, employers must offer open-ended contracts. During the placement period, veterans receive monthly living allowances equal to the local minimum wage. If placement fails due to reasons unrelated to the veteran, they receive 80% of the average wage of comparable workers until employment is secured. Exceptions include individuals expelled from the Communist Party of China or convicted of crimes. Article 51 clarifies that self-employed veterans must register within 30 days of discharge; otherwise, they lose eligibility for government support. (Nationwide, effective 1 September 2024.)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: State Council of China, Central Military Commission (2024). Regulations on the Placement of Veterans (State Council of China, Central Military Commission Order No. 787, promulgated on July 29, 2024, effective on September 1; Articles 25, 31, 32, 35, 51, 75). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11526/202408/content_6969192.html>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2020). Law on the Protection of Veterans (Articles 13, 14, and 15). <http://www.mod.gov.cn/gfbw/fgwx/flfg/16048597.html> (Published by the Ministry of National Defense)
- Notes: This regulation took effect on the same date that the 2011 Regulations on Placement of Retired Soldiers (Decree No. 608 issued by the State Council and Central Military Commission) was repealed. Many online guides still reference the outdated version, which stipulated that veterans must have earned second-class combat merits or higher in peacetime or third-class merits or higher in wartime to qualify. The 30-day registration rule applies solely to self-employed veterans; others must register “within the prescribed timeframe.” Upon registration, veterans receive a preferential treatment certificate, which serves as a prerequisite for subsequent benefits such as pensions, employment support, and educational grants.

title: 退役后的三笔账：一次性退役金、军龄算工龄、自己干每年扣减 20000 元税
englishTitle: Three key financial aspects after discharge: one-time separation pay, military service counting toward work seniority, and tax deductions for self-employed veterans
originalText:
### 6. 退役后的三笔账：一次性退役金、军龄算工龄、自己干每年扣减 20000 元税
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=中 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：不花钱。退役时军队把你的社保关系和钱转出来。你再到安置地的社保经办机构（办社保的窗口）办接续。
- 说人话：退役之后有三笔账。第一笔是自主就业的一次性退役金，按服现役年限发，立过功的还增发。第二笔是当兵这几年不算社保空白，军龄算工龄，缴费年限跟入伍前和退役后合着算。第三笔是税：自己开店做生意的，3 年内每年最多能少交 20000 元的税。
- 收益：第一笔看《退役军人安置条例》。它写着：「对自主就业的退役军士和义务兵，根据其服现役年限发放一次性退役金」。钱由谁出：「由中央财政专项安排，具体标准由国务院退役军人工作主管部门、中央军事委员会政治工作部门会同国务院财政部门……确定，并适时调整」。增发比例分五档。获得勋章、荣誉称号增发 25%，一等战功或一级表彰 20%。二等战功、一等功或二级表彰 15%。三等战功或二等功 10%，四等战功或三等功 5%。该条例还写着：「退役军人未及时就业的，可以依法向户口所在地人力资源社会保障部门申领失业保险待遇，服现役年限视同参保缴费年限，但是以退休、供养方式安置的退役军人除外」。视同缴费年限的意思是，这几年你没交过钱，也按交过算。第二笔看《退役军人保障法》：「退役军人服现役年限计算为工龄，退役后与所在单位工作年限累计计算」。工龄就是参加工作的年数，服役这几年和退役后的年数接着往上加。该法还写着，服现役年限与入伍前、退役后的养老、医疗、失业缴费年限「依法合并计算」，「退役的军士和义务兵服现役经历视为基层工作经历」。《军人保险法》：「军人服现役年限视同职工基本医疗保险缴费年限，与入伍前和退出现役后参加职工基本医疗保险的缴费年限合并计算」。第三笔看财政部、税务总局、退役军人事务部 2023 年第 14 号公告。公告写的是自主就业退役士兵从事个体经营的情形：「在 3 年（36 个月，下同）内按每户每年 20000 元为限额依次扣减其当年实际应缴纳的增值税、城市维护建设税、教育费附加、地方教育附加和个人所得税。限额标准最高可上浮 20%」。扣减就是从当年该交的这几种税里按顺序往下减，减到限额为止，不是发给你的钱。企业招用的「定额标准为每人每年 6000 元，最高可上浮 50%」。执行期为 2023 年 1 月 1 日至 2027 年 12 月 31 日。到期未满 3 年的可继续享受至期满（全国）

### 6. Three key financial aspects after discharge: one-time separation pay, military service counting toward work seniority, and tax deductions for self-employed veterans
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=Low Willpower=No Benefit=Med Metric=Money -->

- Cost: There are no direct costs involved. Upon discharge, the military transfers your social insurance records and payments to you, and you then register these with the local social insurance office.

- In plain terms: After leaving the military, three main financial factors matter. First, there is a one-time separation payment for veterans who choose to work independently; the amount depends on how many years you served, with additional bonuses for those who earned commendations. Second, your military service years count toward your overall work seniority, allowing them to be combined with any pre- or post-discharge work history for social insurance purposes. Third, if you start your own business, you may qualify for tax deductions of up to 20,000 yuan per year for three years.

- Benefit: The first benefit is outlined in the Regulations on the Resettlement of Veterans: “Veterans who choose to work independently receive a one-time separation payment based on their years of service.” This payment is funded by the central government, with specific amounts determined by relevant authorities and adjusted periodically. Additional bonuses are provided in five tiers: 25% for recipients of medals or honorary titles, 20% for those with first-class combat achievements or first-level commendations, 15% for second-class combat achievements or first-level commendations, 10% for third-class combat achievements or second-level commendations, and 5% for fourth-class combat achievements or third-level commendations. The regulations also state that veterans who do not find employment immediately may claim unemployment benefits, with their military service years counted toward insurance contributions, except for those placed in retirement or supported through other programs. The second benefit comes from the Veterans Protection Law: “Military service years are counted toward overall work seniority, which is then combined with any subsequent work history.” This seniority is also factored into pension, medical, and unemployment insurance calculations, and veterans’ service is recognized as equivalent to grassroots work experience under the Military Insurance Law. Finally, a 2023 joint announcement by the Ministry of Finance, State Taxation Administration, and Veterans Affairs Ministry allows self-employed veterans to deduct up to 20,000 yuan per year from their taxes for three years, with a possible 20% increase; this amount is subtracted from the total tax owed rather than provided as a cash payment. Employers hiring veterans may also receive a deduction of up to 6,000 yuan per employee per year, with a 50% increase possible. These provisions are effective from January 1, 2023, through December 31, 2027. It is important to note that this tax benefit is separate from any local “one-time economic subsidies” provided by individual regions, which are determined independently and may vary widely.

- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: State Council of China, Central Military Commission (2024). Regulations on the Placement of Veterans (State Council of China, Central Military Commission Order No. 787, Articles 21, 22, 74, 81, 85). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11526/202408/content_6969192.html>; Ministry of Veterans Affairs (2020). Ten questions about one-time retirement benefits (reprinted from "China Veterans" Issue 10, 2020): "Basic standards. Soldiers will be awarded 4,500 yuan for each year of active service." "Retirement payment standards will be adjusted in due course". <https://www.mva.gov.cn/sy/zzxc/202011/t20201113_43153.html>; Guizhou Provincial Department of Veterans Affairs (2024). One-time additional pension payment, important changes! : "The current standard is: Soldiers will receive 4,500 yuan for each year of active service." <http://tyjrswt.guizhou.gov.cn/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/zdlyxx_5621158/tyaz_5621161/202408/t20240809_85367194.html>; Muping District People's Government of Yantai City (2025). The reply quoted "Notice of Yantai Municipal Veterans Affairs Bureau and Yantai Municipal Finance Bureau on Adjusting the One-time Economic Subsidy Standard for Self-Employed Retired Soldiers": "A subsidy of 6,000 yuan for each year of service for retired soldiers who retire from active service in 2024". <https://www.muping.gov.cn/art/2025/11/10/art_105032_2960250.html>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020). Veterans' Insurance Law (Articles 42, 44, 50). <http://www.mod.gov.cn/gfbw/fgwx/flfg/16048597.html> (published by the Ministry of National Defense); National People's Congress Standing Committee (2012). Military Personnel Insurance Law (Articles 16, 23). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf73e160645> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation, and Ministry of Veterans Affairs (2023). Announcement on tax policies to further support the entrepreneurship and employment of self-employed retired soldiers (No. 14, 2023). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202308/content_6896456.htm>

- Notes: The regulations specify that exact payment amounts will be set by relevant authorities, though an official figure of 4,500 yuan per service year was cited in a 2020 Ministry of Veterans Affairs statement that also noted future adjustments. This figure no longer aligns with current regulations, which must be followed instead. As of August 2024, Guizhou Province’s Veterans Affairs Department continues to reference the 4,500 yuan figure, though no official nationwide standard has been published. Additionally, families of conscripts receive a separate preferential allowance during service, the amount of which is determined locally with some central funding support. The tax deduction described applies only to eligible self-employed veterans and may not be fully utilized if their actual tax liability is lower. A newer regulation effective August 1, 2026, further expands benefits by recognizing professional certifications earned during service as valid nationwide. 〔36〕

### 7. 想进体制内不止考公一条：基层服务项目干满两年，能报每年 10% 的定向考录计划
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=多 毅力=是 收益=中 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：不花钱。代价是到乡镇基层服务两年。这两年拿的是财政补助，不是市场工资，难的是要耐得住这两年。
- 说人话：想进体制内，不是只有考公一条路。「三支一扶」这类基层服务项目干满两年、考核合格，就能报只面向这些人的定向考录计划。各省每年要拿出公务员考录计划的 10% 左右招这些人。三年内考研，初试总分还加 10 分。代价是这两年拿的是财政补助。
- 收益：第四轮「三支一扶」计划通知写着「服务期为两年」。它还写着：「各省（区、市）每年应拿出公务员考录计划的 10％左右，面向『三支一扶』计划等服务基层项目人员定向考录。各省（区、市）县乡基层事业单位公开招聘时，应根据本地区实际拿出一定数量或比例的岗位，对『三支一扶』服务期满考核合格的人员进行专项招聘……聘用后可以不再约定试用期」。定向考录和专项招聘的意思是，这部分名额只在干过基层服务项目的人里面考，别人报不了。同一份通知还写着：「期满考核合格的『三支一扶』人员，三年内参加全国硕士研究生招生考试的，初试总分加 10 分，同等条件下优先录取……高职（高专）毕业生期满且考核合格的，可免试入读成人高等学历教育专科起点本科」。免试入读就是不用再考试，直接去读专升本。通知还写着：「参加『三支一扶』计划前无工作经历的人员期满且考核合格的，两年内在参加机关和企事业单位考录（招聘）、自主创业、落户、升学等方面可同等享受应届毕业生相关政策。『三支一扶』人员在基层服务年限计算为工龄，其参加工作时间按其到基层报到之日起算」。中央财政补助标准为西部地区每人每年 3 万元、中部地区 2.4 万元、东部地区 1.2 万元。中办国办的意见写着：「参加基层服务项目前无工作经历的人员服务期满且考核合格后 2 年内，在参加机关事业单位考录（招聘）、各类企业吸纳就业、自主创业、落户、升学等方面可同等享受应届高校毕业生的相关政策」。该意见还写着：「省级以上机关录用公务员，除特殊职位外，按照有关规定一律从具有 2 年以上基层工作经历的人员中考录」。另一条路是西部计划。它由「共青团中央、教育部、财政部、人力资源社会保障部共同组织实施」。它招募高校应届毕业生或在读研究生，「到西部基层从事为期 1—3 年」的志愿服务（全国）
- 证据等级：A

- 备注：第四轮三支一扶计划管的是 2021 到 2025 年。这次没找到第五轮文件和 2026 年度通知，报名前查当年的招募公告。2025 年中央财政支持招募 34430 名。西部计划的实施方案原文在网上查不到，官网那个政策栏目打不开内容。它期满之后的优惠，按中办国办那份管所有基层服务项目的文件走。这两年拿的是财政补助，不是市场工资，这笔代价要和两年后的定向考录放在一起算。

### 7. There’s more than just civil service exams to get into the government system: serving two years in grassroots programs qualifies you for a special recruitment quota of 10% each year.
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=High Willpower=Yes Benefit=Med Metric=Money -->

- Cost: There’s no upfront cost. The trade‑off is spending two years working at a grassroots level in a township. During those two years you receive a government stipend rather than a market‑rate salary, and you must be prepared to endure that period.

- In plain terms: Getting into the government system isn’t limited to taking civil service exams. After completing two years of satisfactory service in programs such as “Three Supports and One Assistance,” you become eligible for a special recruitment pool that accounts for roughly 10% of each year’s civil service openings. Those who take the postgraduate entrance exam within three years also get an extra 10 points added to their total score. The catch is that you’ll be paid only a government stipend during those two years.

- Benefit: The fourth round of the “Three Supports and One Assistance” program states that the service term is two years. It also specifies that each province must reserve about 10% of its civil service recruitment slots for participants in this and similar grassroots programs. Additionally, local governments are required to set aside a certain number of positions in county‑ and township‑level public institutions for those who have completed the program and passed the evaluation; once hired, they are exempt from a probationary period. This means these spots are open only to former participants, not to outsiders. The same notice adds that anyone who finishes the program and meets the criteria can receive a 10‑point boost on their postgraduate exam score and be given priority admission under equal conditions. Graduates from vocational colleges who meet the requirements may also be admitted to undergraduate programs without taking further exams. Moreover, those without prior work experience who complete the program can enjoy the same rights as fresh graduates for two years in terms of civil service and corporate hiring, entrepreneurship, household registration, and further education; their service time counts as work seniority, with the start date being the day they reported to the grassroots post. Financial support from the central government is 30,000 yuan per person per year for western regions, 24,000 yuan for central regions, and 12,000 yuan for eastern regions. A joint directive from the General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council states that such individuals may enjoy the same treatment as fresh graduates for two years after completing the program, and that most senior posts in central government agencies must be filled by candidates with at least two years of grassroots experience. Another pathway is the Western China Program, jointly organized by the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security; it recruits recent university graduates and postgraduate students to provide volunteer services in western grassroots areas for one to three years.

- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China and ten other departments (2021). Notice on the implementation of the fourth round of the "Three Supports and One Support" plan for college graduates (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China [2021] No. 32, Articles 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-06/04/content_5615404.htm>; General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, General Office of the State Council of China (2017). Opinions on further guiding and encouraging college graduates to work at the grassroots level (Articles 5, 16, and 18). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5171278.htm>; National College Student Volunteer Service Western Plan Project Management Office (2026). 2026-2027 College Student Volunteer Service Western Plan Recruitment Agreement. <http://xibu.youth.cn/tzgg/202604/t20260423_16623558.htm>

- Notes: The fourth round of the “Three Supports and One Assistance” program covers the years 2021‑2025. No fifth‑round documents or 2026 notices have been found yet, so be sure to check the latest recruitment announcements before applying. In 2025 the central government funded the recruitment of 34,430 participants. The full implementation plan for the Western China Program is not publicly available, and the relevant policy page on its official site cannot be accessed. Benefits for graduates of that program are governed by the same CPC‑State Council directive applicable to all grassroots programs. Keep in mind that you must actually serve the full two years under a government stipend; don’t focus solely on the subsequent special recruitment opportunities.

### 8. 特岗教师三年服务期满、考核合格又愿意留下的，应当及时入编
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=多 毅力=是 收益=大 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：不花钱。代价是三年在农村义务教育学校任教，进门前还得先考出教师资格证。难的是这三年要待得住。
- 说人话：特岗计划是少数几条写明「期满入编」的路。条件是本科及以上学历、以师范类专业为主，年龄不超过 30 周岁，还要有相应的教师资格证。服务期三年，这三年的工资待遇跟当地公办学校的在编教师一样。三年期满考核合格、又愿意留下的，文件要求及时入编。
- 收益：2024 年特岗计划通知写的招聘条件是：「要求本科及以上学历，以师范类专业为主，小学阶段可适当招聘师范高等专科学校毕业生」。「年龄不超过 30 周岁」。还须具有相应的教师资格证书。通知另写着：「参加过『大学生志愿服务西部计划』、有从教经历的志愿者和参加过半年以上实习支教的师范院校毕业生同等条件下优先录取」。「支持鼓励符合条件的退役军人到中小学任教，可综合考虑服役年限等因素对退役军人相应放宽年龄限制」。待遇和入编看这几句。「从 2024 年 1 月 1 日起，提高特岗教师工资性补助标准，中央财政……中部地区由年人均 3.52 万元提高到 3.88 万元，西部地区由 3.82 万元提高到 4.18 万元」。「同等条件下在薪酬待遇、职称评聘、评先评优、年度考核等方面享受与当地公办学校在编教师同等待遇」。「保证三年服务期满、考核合格且愿意留任的特岗教师及时入编并落实工作岗位，做好相关人事、工资关系等接转工作，连续计算工龄、教龄，不再实行试用期」（全国）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：教育部办公厅、财政部办公厅 (2024). 关于做好 2024 年农村义务教育阶段学校教师特设岗位计划实施工作的通知（教师厅〔2024〕1 号）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6950803.htm>

englishText:
### 8. Teachers in the Special Post Program who complete three years of service, pass evaluations, and wish to stay should be promptly added to the official teaching staff
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=High Willpower=Yes Benefit=High Metric=Money -->

- Cost: There is no monetary cost. The price to pay is three years of teaching in rural compulsory education schools; applicants must also obtain a teaching certificate beforehand. The real challenge lies in staying committed throughout those three years.

- In plain terms: The Special Post Program is one of the few pathways explicitly stating that eligible participants can be added to the official teaching roster after completing their service term. Requirements include a bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a teacher-training field, age not exceeding 30, and possession of the required teaching certificate. During those three years, compensation matches that of regular teachers employed by local public schools. Once the term ends, those who meet evaluation standards and wish to remain are supposed to be promptly added to the official staff list.

- Benefit: The 2024 notice regarding the Special Post Program outlines hiring criteria: applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably from a teacher-training background; for elementary schools, graduates from teacher-training colleges may also qualify. Age limit remains 30. A valid teaching certificate is mandatory. The notice further states that volunteers who participated in the “Western China Volunteer Program” or have prior teaching experience, as well as teacher-training graduates with at least six months of teaching internships, receive preferential treatment under equal conditions. Eligible veterans may also be considered for teaching roles in primary and secondary schools, with age limits adjusted based on their years of service. Compensation and official employment terms are defined accordingly: starting January 1, 2024, central government subsidies for Special Post teachers rose from 35,200 yuan per year in central regions to 38,800 yuan, and from 38,200 yuan in western regions to 41,800 yuan. These teachers are entitled to identical pay, professional title evaluations, awards, and annual assessments as regular teachers employed by local public schools. Upon successful completion of three years of service and passing evaluations, they must be promptly added to the official staff list, with all personnel and salary records transferred accordingly; their years of service and teaching experience are counted continuously, and no probationary period applies nationwide.

- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: General Office of Ministry of Education of China, General Office of the Ministry of Finance (2024). Notice on the implementation of the plan for special posts for school teachers in rural compulsory education in 2024 (Teacher Office [2024] No. 1). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6950803.htm>

- Notes: The benefit level is classified as “high” because securing official employment after completing the program represents a long-term career gain far exceeding any monetary value. The most recent publicly available document is the 2024 notice; policies for 2025 and 2026 have not yet been published. Exact postings, subsidy amounts, and age limits are determined by each province’s implementation plan within the central framework. Obtaining a teaching certificate beforehand is mandatory; it serves as a prerequisite for entry, not something that can be obtained after employment begins.

title: 消防员和军队文职是另外两个公开招录的口子，门槛比考公低
englishTitle: Firefighters and civilian personnel in the military represent two additional pathways for public recruitment, with lower entry requirements than civil service exams.
originalText:
### 9. 消防员和军队文职是另外两个公开招录的口子，门槛比考公低
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=中 毅力=些 收益=中 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：不花钱。从报名到录用要走体检、政治考核、体能测试、心理测试和面试，前后几个月。难在这几关一关一关刷人。
- 说人话：这两条路都不卡「大专以上」这道门槛。消防员招 18 到 22 周岁、高中以上文化程度的人，大专以上学历的人和退役士兵可以放宽到 24 周岁。军队文职只要求年满 18 周岁，入门层级的岗位首次招录最高 35 周岁。共同的代价是政治考核和体检刷人。
- 收益：消防员看《国家综合性消防救援队伍消防员招录办法》。第五条基本条件含「年龄为 18 周岁以上、22 周岁以下」「具有高中以上文化程度」。第六条「大学专科以上学历人员、解放军和武警部队退役士兵、具有 2 年以上灭火救援实战经验的政府专职消防队员和政府专职林业扑火队员，年龄可以放宽至 24 周岁；对消防救援工作急需的特殊专业人才，经应急管理部批准年龄可以进一步放宽，原则上不超过 28 周岁」。第七条「消防员面向社会公开招录，主要从本省级行政区域常住人口中招录，根据需要也可以面向其他省份招录」。第九条写的招录程序是「宣传动员、组织报名、资格审查、体格检查、政治考核、体能测试和岗位适应性测试、心理测试和面试、公示、录用」。军队文职看《中国人民解放军文职人员条例》第十八条「军队实行公开招考、直接引进、专项招录相结合的文职人员招录聘用制度」。这是三条线：公开考试招人，直接引进现成的人才，面向特定人群专门招。该条例第九条基本条件含「年满 18 周岁」「符合军队招录聘用文职人员的政治条件」「符合岗位要求的文化程度、专业水平和工作能力」。第十九条写明，较低职级岗位首次招录聘用最高年龄 35 周岁。该条例还写明「文职人员岗位应当优先招录聘用符合条件的退役军人」（全国）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：人力资源社会保障部、应急管理部 (2021). 国家综合性消防救援队伍消防员招录办法（人社部发〔2021〕58 号，第五、六、七、九条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-08/27/content_5633684.htm>；国务院、中央军委 (2022). 中国人民解放军文职人员条例（第二次修订，国务院、中央军委令第 757 号，2023 年 1 月 1 日施行；第九、十八、十九、二十条）. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181857bca5e01859ee5a6c06d62>（国家法律法规数据库）
- 备注：2026 年 8 月 1 日起施行的《退役军人就业创业促进条例》另写明了两件事。一是消防员招录要拿出一定比例，专门招退役军士和义务兵。二是招警务辅助人员（辅警）的时候，同等条件下优先招退役军人。这两条路每年的名额、岗位和具体条件都以当年公告为准，本书只写办法里固定不变的门槛。消防员是纪律部队的岗位，进去之前把职业风险想清楚。
englishText:
### 9. Firefighters and civilian personnel in the military represent two additional pathways for public recruitment, with lower entry requirements than civil service exams.  
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=Med Willpower=Some Benefit=Med Metric=Money -->
- Cost: There is no monetary cost. The process from application to hiring involves medical exams, political background checks, physical fitness tests, psychological evaluations, and interviews, taking several months in total. The difficulty lies in the successive screening stages that eliminate candidates one by one.  
- In plain terms: Neither pathway imposes the “minimum associate degree or higher” requirement. Firefighter recruitment targets individuals aged 18–22 with at least a high school education; those with an associate degree or higher, as well as veterans, may apply up to age 24. Military civilian positions require applicants to be at least 18 years old, with entry-level roles allowing candidates up to 35 years of age. The common barrier is the rigorous political background checks and medical evaluations.  
- Benefit: For firefighters, refer to the *Measures for Recruiting Firefighters into the National Comprehensive Fire and Rescue Force*. Article 5 stipulates that applicants must be aged 18–22 and hold at least a high school diploma. Article 6 further allows candidates with an associate degree or higher, veterans, or experienced firefighters to apply up to age 24; exceptionally talented specialists may be admitted up to age 28 with approval from the Ministry of Emergency Management. Article 7 specifies that recruitment occurs primarily among local residents, though candidates from other provinces may also be considered. Article 9 outlines the full procedure: publicity, registration, eligibility checks, medical exams, political screening, physical and psychological tests, interviews, public announcements, and final hiring. Regarding military civilian roles, the *Regulations on Civilian Personnel in the Chinese People’s Liberation Army* states in Article 18 that recruitment combines open examinations, direct hiring, and targeted recruitment efforts. Article 9 lists basic criteria: applicants must be at least 18 years old, meet political standards, and possess required education, expertise, and competence. Article 19 sets the maximum age limit at 35 for entry-level positions. Additionally, Article 20 emphasizes giving priority to veterans in civilian roles nationwide.  
- Evidence grade: A  
- Sources: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China, Ministry of Emergency Management of China (2021). Recruitment Methods for Firefighters in the National Comprehensive Fire Rescue Team (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China [2021] No. 58, Articles 5, 6, 7, and 9). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-08/27/content_5633684.htm>; State Council of China, Central Military Commission (2022). Regulations on Civilian Personnel of the Chinese People's Liberation Army (Second Revision, State Council of China, Central Military Commission Order No. 757, effective January 1, 2023; 9th, 18th, 19th, Article 20). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181857bca5e01859ee5a6c06d62> (National Laws and Regulations Database)
- Notes: Effective August 1, 2026, the *Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship for Veterans* introduces two key provisions: first, a designated quota for recruiting veterans into firefighter roles; second, preferential treatment for veterans when hiring police auxiliary personnel. These pathways’ exact annual quotas, specific roles, and eligibility criteria are defined in yearly announcements; this guide outlines only the unchanging baseline requirements. Firefighter roles constitute a disciplined service rather than ordinary employment, so prospective candidates must carefully weigh associated occupational risks beforehand.

title: 学历不是一锤子买卖：自考不限年龄和已受教育程度，成人高考和开放大学都能补
englishTitle: Education is not a one-time deal: self-study exams have no age or prior education limits; both adult college entrance exams and open universities offer pathways to further education.
originalText:
### 10. 学历不是一锤子买卖：自考不限年龄和已受教育程度，成人高考和开放大学都能补
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=少 时间=多 毅力=是 收益=中 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：报名费和教材费每年几百元。代价是长期自学，或者业余去上课，非脱产（边工作边读）的专升本最短要读两年半，难在要长期坚持。
- 说人话：十八岁那年没读成书，后面还有三条正规通道：自考、成人高考、开放大学。自考不限年龄，也不看你原来读到哪一级，但全日制在校生不能报。成人高考要先有高中或者专科的毕业证。三条路都慢，但都不看你十八岁那年考成什么样。

- 证据等级：A
- 来源：国务院 (1988, 2014 修订). 高等教育自学考试暂行条例（第三、二十、二十五、三十二条）. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f3cbb3c016f415d64e5236d>（国家法律法规数据库）；全国人大常委会 (2018). 高等教育法（第二十一条）. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f20df64ec16c5>（国家法律法规数据库）；教育部办公厅 (2025). 关于做好 2025 年全国成人高校招生工作的通知（教学厅〔2025〕6 号）及附件《2025 年全国成人高校招生办法》. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202509/content_7040877.htm>；教育部 (2016). 关于办好开放大学的意见（教职成〔2016〕2 号）. <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2016/content_5067956.htm>；教育部 (2007). 关于进一步做好高等学校各类招生管理工作的通知（教发〔2007〕13 号）：「普通专升本招生计划按不超过当年应届普通高职（专科）毕业生5%的比例安排」. <http://www.moe.gov.cn/s78/A03/s7050/201006/t20100607_88782.html>；中国政府网 (2020). 今年扩招硕士18.9万，专升本32.2万——毕业生就业帮扶发力，教育部副部长翁铁慧：「扩大普通高校专升本的规模，同比争取增加32.2万人」. <http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2020-02/29/content_5484774.htm>；福建省教育考试院 (2026). 转发时引「教育部高校学生司《关于做好2026年普通高等学校专升本考试招生工作的通知》（教学司函〔2025〕53号）」. <https://www.eeafj.cn/gkzsb/20260310/14437.html>

### 10. Education is not a one-time deal: self-study exams have no age or prior education limits; both adult college entrance exams and open universities offer pathways to further education.
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=Low Time=High Willpower=Yes Benefit=Med Metric=Money -->
- Cost: Registration and textbook fees amount to only a few hundred yuan per year. The trade-off is the need for long-term self-study or part-time classes; for those pursuing a bachelor’s degree while still working, the minimum study period is two and a half years, which requires consistent dedication over time.
- In plain terms: If you missed out on higher education at age 18, there are three legitimate options available: self-study exams, adult college entrance exams, and open universities. Self-study exams impose no age restrictions or limits on prior educational attainment, though full-time students are ineligible to apply. Adult college entrance exams require applicants to hold a high school diploma or equivalent. All three routes take time, but none depend on how well you performed academically at age 18.
- Benefit: The Regulations on Self-Study Examinations for Higher Education explicitly state in Article 3: “All citizens of the People’s Republic of China, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, race, or prior educational background, may participate in self-study examinations for higher education in accordance with these regulations.” Article 20 adds that full-time students at all levels of education are barred from taking these exams. Article 25 outlines three requirements for earning a diploma: successfully completing all required courses, finishing a graduation thesis or practical assignment, and meeting criteria for moral conduct. Once these conditions are met, a diploma is granted. It further notes that “diplomas awarded for associate or bachelor’s degrees are recognized by the state.” Article 32 guarantees that non-working graduates receive the same salary treatment as peers from regular higher education institutions. Article 21 of the Higher Education Law also affirms that self-study examinations are a state-recognized pathway to higher education, with successful candidates receiving corresponding academic credentials. The 2025 National Enrollment Rules for Adult Higher Education state that eligible applicants must be “working professionals and other members of society who are not currently enrolled in any nationally recognized high or secondary schools.” Those applying for undergraduate or associate programs must hold a high school diploma or equivalent, while applicants for bachelor’s degrees must already hold an associate diploma, bachelor’s certificate, or higher. Full-time study requires a minimum of four years for undergraduates and two years for associate or bachelor’s degree candidates; part-time study demands five years for undergraduates and two and a half years for the other two pathways. Full-time study means leaving one’s job to attend classes full-time, while part-time study allows individuals to continue working while pursuing their degree. The Ministry of Education’s guidelines on open universities specify that registration is open to all; upon completing required coursework and earning sufficient credits, students receive course certificates, and those meeting all academic and conduct criteria earn academic or non-academic credentials, with degrees awarded where applicable (nationwide).
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: State Council of China (1988, revised in 2014). Interim Regulations on Higher Education Self-study Examinations (Articles 3, 20, 25, and 32). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f3cbb3c016f415d64e5236d> (National Laws and Regulations Database); National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). Higher Education Law (Article 21). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f20df64ec16c5> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Ministry of Education of China (2025). Notice on the National Adult College Enrollment Work in 2025 (Teaching Department [2025] 6 No.) and the attachment "2025 National Adult College Enrollment Measures". <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202509/content_7040877.htm>; Ministry of Education of China (2016). Opinions on Running Open Universities (Jiaozhengcheng [2016] No. 2). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2016/content_5067956.htm>; Ministry of Education of China (2007). Notice on further improving the management of various types of enrollment in colleges and universities (Jiaofa [2007] No. 13): "The enrollment plan for general junior college to bachelor's degree shall be arranged according to a proportion of no more than 5% of the general vocational (junior college) graduates of that year." <http://www.moe.gov.cn/s78/A03/s7050/201006/t20100607_88782.html>; China Government Network (2020). This year, 189,000 master’s students will be enrolled, and 322,000 will be promoted from junior college to bachelor’s degree—employment support for graduates, Ministry of Education of China Deputy Minister Weng Tiehui: "Expand the scale of junior college to bachelor's degree in general colleges and universities, and strive to increase the number of 322,000 people year-on-year". <http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2020-02/29/content_5484774.htm>; Fujian Provincial Education Examination Agency (2026). When forwarding, it is quoted as "Ministry of Education of China's Higher Education Student Affairs Department's "Notice on the Enrollment of the 2026 Junior College to Bachelor's Degree Examination in General Colleges and Universities" (Teaching Secretary Letter [2025] No. 53) ". <https://www.eeafj.cn/gkzsb/20260310/14437.html>
- Notes: There is also a separate pathway called “regular bachelor’s degree programs for associate graduates,” governed by a 2007 Ministry of Education notice that originally capped enrollment at 5% of that year’s associate graduates. Starting in 2020, this cap was lifted, with enrollment rising by 322,000 students that year. Annual enrollment details are set by internal ministry directives, such as Document No. 53 (2025) issued by the Department of Higher Education; these documents are not publicly released, only referenced in provincial-level notices. Eligibility is determined by each province, typically limited to local associate graduates, so it is not detailed here. As of autumn 2025, higher education for adults is no longer referred to as “correspondence” or “part-time” study, with “part-time” now the official term. This form of education is distinct from skill-based training, which is covered in Section 23. Be cautious of any “quick certification” schemes or unaccredited credentials advertised as equivalent to official diplomas; these are also addressed in Section 23, Item 8.

### 11. 不进单位就是灵活就业：养老和医疗要自己在就业地参保，户籍限制已经放开
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=多 时间=少 毅力=些 收益=大 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：养老和医疗要你全额自己缴，按当地的缴费基数算，每月上千元。缴费基数就是一个用来算保费的基准数。这是灵活就业最容易被漏算的固定支出，难在每个月都得按时交。
- 说人话：不进单位，不等于没有社保这回事，只是没人替你交那一半。文件要求各地放开灵活就业人员在就业地参保的户籍限制，个别超大城市可以逐步放开。所以别把「自由」理解成不用管社保。断着不交，退休金和医保报销都要按断缴的规则算。
- 收益：参保看《关于维护新就业形态劳动者劳动保障权益的指导意见》。它写着：「各地要放开灵活就业人员在就业地参加基本养老、基本医疗保险的户籍限制，个别超大型城市难以一步实现的，要结合本地实际，积极创造条件逐步放开。组织未参加职工基本养老、职工基本医疗保险的灵活就业人员，按规定参加城乡居民基本养老、城乡居民基本医疗保险，做到应保尽保。督促企业依法参加社会保险。企业要引导和支持不完全符合确立劳动关系情形的新就业形态劳动者根据自身情况参加相应的社会保险」。同一份文件把用工分成三类：「符合确立劳动关系情形的，企业应当依法与劳动者订立劳动合同。不完全符合确立劳动关系情形但企业对劳动者进行劳动管理……指导企业与劳动者订立书面协议……个人依托平台自主开展经营活动、从事自由职业等，按照民事法律调整双方的权利义务」（全国，2021 年起）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：人力资源社会保障部等八部门 (2021). 关于维护新就业形态劳动者劳动保障权益的指导意见（人社部发〔2021〕56 号，第二、八条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-07/23/content_5626761.htm>；国务院办公厅 (2020). 关于支持多渠道灵活就业的意见（国办发〔2020〕27 号）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-07/31/content_5531613.htm>
- 备注：原文写的是「放开」户籍限制，还给超大城市留了口子，不是「全国已经取消」。到底放开到什么程度，问你要参保的那个城市。收益量级定「大」，是因为断缴丢的是养老和医疗待遇本身，值的钱远过万元。但成本也实打实，全额自缴每月上千元。社保断缴之后怎么补、年限怎么累计，见第 7 节第 18 条（社保断缴）。换城市以后养老和医保关系怎么转过去，见第 19 节第 19 条（养老和医保关系转到新参保地）。自己交职工养老按哪一档交、要领多少年才回本，见第 5 节第 46 条（自己交职工养老保险）。另外，在政府指定的地点和时间卖农副产品、日用品，或者用自己的手艺做依法不需要许可的便民活儿，不用办营业执照。这一条写在国办发〔2020〕27 号里。

### 11. Not joining a company means you must arrange your own social insurance: you’ll need to enroll in pension and medical plans at your place of work, as household registration restrictions have now been lifted.
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=High Time=Low Willpower=Some Benefit=High Metric=Money -->
- Cost: You must pay the full amount for both pension and medical insurance yourself, calculated based on the local contribution base — often over a thousand yuan per month. The contribution base is simply the benchmark figure used to determine premiums. This is the most easily overlooked recurring expense on this path, and the difficulty lies in making those payments on time every month.
- In plain terms: Not being employed by a company doesn’t mean you’re exempt from social insurance; it simply means no employer covers half of the cost. Official documents require all regions to lift household registration barriers so flexible workers can enroll in insurance at their place of work, with major metropolises gradually implementing this change. So don’t mistake “freedom” for “no need to worry about social insurance.” If you fail to pay on schedule, both your pension benefits and medical reimbursement rates will be calculated according to rules for interrupted coverage.
- Benefit: These provisions stem from the “Guiding Opinions on Protecting the Labor Rights and Interests of Workers in New Forms of Employment.” It states: “All regions must lift household registration restrictions so flexible workers can enroll in basic pension and medical insurance at their place of work; for exceptionally large cities where full implementation isn’t immediately feasible, local authorities should create conditions for gradual rollout. Employers must be urged to enroll workers in social insurance per the law. Workers who don’t qualify for standard employee pension or medical plans should be guided to enroll in urban/rural resident programs to ensure full coverage. For those operating independently via platforms, rights and obligations are governed by civil law.” (National policy, effective 2021)
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China and eight other ministries (2021). Guidance on safeguarding the labor security rights and interests of workers in new employment forms (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China [2021] No. 56, Article 2, Article 8). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-07/23/content_5626761.htm>; General Office of State Council of China (2020). Opinions on supporting multiple channels for flexible employment (Guobanfa [2020] No. 27). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-07/31/content_5531613.htm>
- Notes: The wording “lift restrictions” leaves room for exceptions in very large cities — it doesn’t mean household registration rules are completely abolished nationwide. Exact implementation details depend on the specific city where you intend to enroll. The benefit is rated “high” because interrupted coverage directly impacts long-term pension and medical benefits, which far outweigh the monthly costs. Yet those costs are real too: full self-payment often exceeds a thousand yuan per month. For information on how to restore interrupted coverage and accumulate years of service, see Section 7, Article 18 (“Interrupted Social Insurance Payments”). Additionally, selling agricultural or daily goods at government-designated locations/times, or offering services that legally require no license, doesn’t necessitate a business license per State Council Document No. 27 (2020).

### 12. 送外卖、跑网约车、拉同城货运，平台按单给你交职业伤害保障费，自己不缴
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=中 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：不花钱，这笔钱由平台缴。你要做的是查自己接单的平台在不在试点里。办法有两个：在 App 的保障或权益页面找「职业伤害保障」，或者打本省人社局的电话，问这家平台报没报。
- 说人话：送外卖、跑网约车、拉同城货运的人，平台要按单替你缴职业伤害保障费，你自己一分钱不出，每接一单就保一单。这还是试点，接单前先查自己所在的省份和平台在不在范围里。已经和平台建立劳动关系的，走工伤保险，不走这套。

- 证据等级：A

- 备注：这还是试点，不是全国都有的正式制度。接单前确认你所在的省份和平台在不在范围里，不在的就只剩自己买商业保险这一层。另一份文件《关于维护新就业形态劳动者劳动保障权益的指导意见》还提了几条要求。平台给正常干活的人开的报酬不低于当地最低工资，要按时足额发，不得克扣或者无故拖欠。法定节假日还要付合理报酬。这份文件的文号是人社部发〔2021〕56 号，灵活就业那条也引了它，见第 11 条。出了事先照这套走，别先跟站点私了。医保和养老那一块还得自己参保，灵活就业参保见第 11 条。

### 12. Food delivery workers, ride‑hailing drivers, and local freight carriers all get occupational injury coverage paid for by the platform on a per‑order basis — at no cost to them.
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=Low Willpower=No Benefit=Med Metric=Money -->

- Cost: Zero out‑of‑pocket expense; the platform bears the entire premium. Your only task is to verify whether the platform you use is part of the pilot program. Two easy ways to do this: check the “Occupational Injury Coverage” section in the app’s benefits page, or call your provincial Human Resources and Social Security Bureau to ask if the platform is enrolled.
- In plain terms: Platforms must pay occupational injury insurance premiums for every order placed by delivery workers, ride‑hailing drivers, and local freight carriers — none of that cost falls on the workers themselves. This is still a pilot scheme, so before accepting any orders, confirm that both your province and your platform are included. Workers who already have a formal employment contract with a platform are covered under regular workers’ compensation, not this program.
- Benefit: The coverage is governed by the “Interim Measures for Occupational Injury Insurance for Workers in New Forms of Employment.” Article 2 states: “Platform enterprises shall enroll in occupational injury insurance for new‑form workers as required by these measures… ensuring coverage for every order and every worker who registers via the platform and receives compensation for services such as ride‑hailing, delivery, and local freight.” Article 9 specifies premium rates during the trial phase: 0.01 yuan per order for ride‑hailing, 0.07 yuan and 0.25 yuan per order for delivery, and 0.18 yuan per order for local freight. Starting July 1 2025, the pilot expanded to ten additional provinces, and by 2026 it is slated to cover all 31 provinces and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.
- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China and nine other ministries (2025). Notice on Expanding the Pilot Program of Occupational Injury Protection for Personnel in New Employment Forms (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China [2025] No. 24) and the attachment "Measures for Occupational Injury Protection for Personnel in New Employment Formations (Trial)" Article 2, 9. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7031656.htm>
- Notes: This remains a pilot program, not a nationwide mandatory system. Before taking any orders, verify that your province and platform are part of it; otherwise you’ll need to purchase private insurance on your own. The “Guiding Opinions on Protecting Labor Rights of Workers in New Forms of Employment” also mandates that platforms pay wages no lower than the local minimum, pay on time and in full, and provide fair compensation on statutory holidays. The document’s reference number is HRSSB [2021] 56; it is cited in Rule 11 of this section regarding flexible-employment workers. In any dispute, follow these rules rather than settling privately with the platform. For medical insurance and pension contributions, flexible-employment workers must enroll separately — see Rule 11 of this section for details.

title: 高考填志愿那天就能锁定编制的两条路：公费师范生和定向医学生，代价是 6 年履约
englishTitle: Two pathways to secure a government job on the day you fill out college applications: government-funded teacher training and targeted medical student programs, at the cost of a six-year service commitment.
originalText:
### 13. 高考填志愿那天就能锁定编制的两条路：公费师范生和定向医学生，代价是 6 年履约
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=多 毅力=是 收益=大 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：学费和住宿费都不用你出，还能拿生活费补助。代价是毕业后 6 年不能自由择业，违约要退钱、交违约金、进信用记录。难在这 6 年里换不了地方。
- 说人话：这两条路都是国家先替你出钱，你毕业后按协议去指定的地方干 6 年。公费师范生只在六所教育部直属师范大学招，提前批录取。定向医学生在拿到入学通知书前就要签三方协议。违约要退钱、交违约金，还进信用记录。想清楚这 6 年能不能接受，再填志愿。
- 收益：公费师范生看《教育部直属师范大学本研衔接师范生公费教育实施办法》（2024 年，2018 年办法同时废止）。第二条：由中央财政承担学生在校期间学费、住宿费并给予生活费补助。第三条：重点为中西部地区省会城市之外的地（市、州、盟）及以下培养。它还写着「不得定向到直辖市、计划单列市或省会城市主城区任教（五个自治区、陆地边境省份、海南省、贵州省、青海省除外）」。第九条：毕业后一般回生源所在省份定向地（市、州、盟）中小学任教，「承诺从事中小学教育工作 6 年以上」。到城镇学校工作的，「应到农村义务教育学校任教服务至少 1 年」。第十三条：没履约或者履约期限不够的，按协议承担责任。后果之一是「违约行为纳入信用记录，并及时与全国信用信息共享平台共享，违约相关材料归入本人人事档案」。另一句是「履约任务完成前不得到定向地（市、州、盟）之外从教，不得被招录（聘用）为其他公务人员。完成履约任务后即修复相关信用」。协议约定的服务期没干满之前，别的公职岗位报不了；干满了，信用记录才恢复。第六条：录取后经考察不适合从教的，入学 1 年内退还已享受的公费教育费用，并调整到非师范专业。第十四条：没在规定学习年限内取得教育硕士学历学位证书和教师资格证书的，按违约处理，退费并缴纳违约金。第二十一条：各地在现有事业编制总量内，解决公费师范生到中小学任教所需编制。农村订单定向免费医学生看另一份通知。录取后、获得入学通知书前，须与培养学校和定向就业所在地县级卫生健康、人社部门签署协议。协议里要「承诺毕业后到定向农村基层医疗卫生机构服务 6 年」。履约就是按协议去指定的地方干满。履约报到就业后，须参加 3 年全科专业住院医师规范化培训，简称规培。规培就是毕业后在医院按统一标准接着练本事的阶段。培训期间原人事、工资关系不变。违约记录归入个人人事档案，并作为医疗卫生机构等行政事业单位公开招录（招聘）、住院医师规范化培训招收、研究生招生录取的诚信评价依据。恶意违约的人，通过「信用中国」网站全国公示，并实行失信联合惩戒。违约的培训年限不计入服务期。没按协议退还费用和违约金的，由县级卫生健康行政部门通过法律途径追缴（全国）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：国务院办公厅 (2024). 关于转发教育部等部门《教育部直属师范大学本研衔接师范生公费教育实施办法》的通知（国办发〔2024〕27 号，第二、三、六、九、十三、十四、二十一条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202406/content_6957261.htm>；国家卫生健康委、中央编办、国家发展改革委、教育部、财政部、人力资源社会保障部、国家中医药局 (2019). 关于做好农村订单定向免费培养医学生就业安置和履约管理工作的通知. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-11/13/content_5451684.htm>
- 备注：2024 年那份办法把公费师范生改成了「本研衔接」（本科接着读教育硕士）。2018 年的老办法已经废止，网上还在传的「本科毕业直接任教」是旧说法。办法发布前已经签了协议的，按原协议走。「有编制」不等于「进去就不用管」：编制要在现有总量里腾，具体岗位由地市组织用人学校专门招聘，你和学校互相挑。定向医学生服务期满想走是可以的，文件写明「服务期满，对自主择业的应予同意」。已经违约的也有把违约记录消掉的办法，代价是按原协议、或者改到省内其他农村基层机构再干满至少 6 年，已交的费用和违约金不退。医学生还要算上 3 年规培的时间，整个周期比师范长。各省还有自己的公费师范生和定向医学生计划，条件由省里定，填志愿前看当年本省的招生文件。

### 13. Two pathways to secure a government job on the day you fill out college applications: government-funded teacher training and targeted medical student programs, at the cost of a six-year service commitment.
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=High Willpower=Yes Benefit=High Metric=Money -->

- Cost: Tuition and housing fees are waived, and you receive a living stipend. The trade-off is that for six years after graduation you cannot freely choose a career; breaking the contract requires you to repay all funds, pay a penalty, and accept a negative mark on your credit record. The difficulty lies in the fact that you cannot relocate during these six years.

- In plain terms: Both programs involve the state covering your education costs upfront; in return, you must work at a designated location for six years after graduation. Government-funded teacher training is offered only at six universities directly under the Ministry of Education, with admission occurring in an early admission round. For targeted medical students, a tripartite agreement must be signed before receiving the admission letter. Violating the contract leads to repayment obligations, penalties, and a credit record impact. Carefully consider whether you can accept these six years of commitment before applying.

- Benefit: Government-funded teacher training is governed by the “Implementation Measures for Government-Funded Education of Teacher-Training Students with Undergraduate-Graduate Continuation at Universities Directly Under the Ministry of Education” (2024), which supersedes the 2018 version. Article 2 stipulates that central government funds cover tuition, housing, and living stipends. Article 3 specifies that training targets areas below provincial capitals in central and western regions (except for five autonomous regions, border provinces, Hainan, Guizhou, and Qinghai). It also states that placement is not permitted in municipalities, special economic zones, or main urban districts of provincial capitals. Article 9 requires graduates to teach at designated primary or secondary schools within their home province for at least six years; those assigned to urban schools must spend at least one year teaching in rural areas. Article 13 mandates accountability for non-compliance, including credit record inclusion and exclusion from other civil service roles until the term ends. Article 6 allows reclassification to non-teacher majors if unsuited for teaching within one year, with repayment of benefits. Article 14 treats failure to obtain a master’s degree and teaching certification as a breach, requiring repayment and penalties. Article 21 ensures that sufficient government posts are allocated for these graduates. Targeted medical students follow a separate policy: prior to enrollment, they sign an agreement with their university and local health and human resources authorities to serve rural medical institutions for six years. After employment, they must complete three years of standardized residency training. Their breach records are similarly logged, and severe violations are publicly disclosed. Unlike teachers, medical graduates may leave after fulfilling their six-year term, as explicitly permitted by regulations.

- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: General Office of State Council of China (2024). Notice on forwarding the "Implementation Measures for Publicly Funded Education for Normal Students in Normal Universities Directly Affiliated to the Ministry of Education of China" issued by the Ministry of Education of China and other departments (Guobanfa [2024] No. 27, No. 2, 3, 6, 9, 13, 14, 21). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202406/content_6957261.htm>; National Health Commission of China (NHC), National Development and Reform Commission of China, Ministry of Education of China, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of China, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine (2019). Notice on the employment placement and contract performance management of rural order-oriented and free training medical students. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-11/13/content_5451684.htm>

- Notes: The 2024 policy shifted teacher training to an undergraduate-graduate continuum, rendering the older “immediate post-graduation teaching” model obsolete. Existing agreements remain valid. Securing a government post does not guarantee automatic placement; actual assignments depend on local hiring needs. Medical students must also account for three years of residency, extending their total commitment period. Individual provinces may offer additional programs with varying criteria; always consult the latest local admissions documents.

title: 想出国打工，先查这家公司有没有对外劳务合作经营资格：它不得向你收押金
englishTitle: Before going abroad to work, check whether the company has a license for international labor cooperation: it is illegal for them to demand a deposit from you.
originalText:
### 14. 想出国打工，先查这家公司有没有对外劳务合作经营资格：它不得向你收押金
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=少 毅力=否 收益=大 口径=自由 -->
- 成本：不花钱。出发前花十几分钟核一下公司资质，再把两份合同看完。
- 说人话：出国打工这件事，法律管的不是你，是组织你出去的那家公司。只有拿到对外劳务合作经营资格证书、又办了登记的企业才能干这个。听到「先办旅游签过去再转工签」，这句话本身就说明对方在违法。公司也不得以任何名目向你收押金，或者要你拿财产做担保。
- 收益：《对外劳务合作管理条例》第五条：从事对外劳务合作应当经省级或者设区的市级商务主管部门批准取得经营资格。这个经营资格就是那张对外劳务合作经营资格证书，没有它就不能组织人出国干活。第七条：经营资格证书名单报国务院商务主管部门，并通报中国驻外使馆、领馆。这一条还写着「未依法取得对外劳务合作经营资格证书并办理登记，不得从事对外劳务合作」。第八条：「任何单位和个人不得以商务、旅游、留学等名义组织劳务人员赴国外工作」。第九条：企业应当自登记之日起 5 个工作日内在指定银行缴存「不低于 300 万元人民币的对外劳务合作风险处置备用金」，缴存名单向社会公布。第十条：备用金用于支付企业拒绝承担或者无力承担的应退服务费、劳动报酬和依法赔偿的损失。它还用于「因发生突发事件，劳务人员回国或者接受紧急救助所需费用」。第十一条：不得组织劳务人员赴国外从事与赌博、色情活动相关的工作。第十二条：没安排培训的不得组织出国。第十三条：应当为劳务人员购买在国外工作期间的人身意外伤害保险。第二十一、二十三条：须与国外雇主、与劳务人员分别订立书面合同，没订立的不得组织出国。第二十五条：「不得以任何名目向劳务人员收取押金或者要求劳务人员提供财产担保」。第二十六条：合同订立之日起 10 个工作日内报商务主管部门备案。第二十九条：劳务人员实际权益与合同不符的，企业应当协助索赔；没得到应有赔偿的，有权要求企业承担赔偿责任。第三十一条：有关国家或者地区安全状况难以保障人身安全的，企业不得组织劳务人员前往。第三十七条：商务主管部门建立不良信用记录和公告制度。罚则在后面几条。第三十九条：没资格从事对外劳务合作的，查处取缔，构成犯罪的追究刑事责任。第四十条：以商务、旅游、留学名义组织出国、出借资格、组织从事赌博色情相关工作的，吊销经营资格证书。第四十三条：没签合同、或者隐瞒信息、提供虚假信息组织出国的，罚 10 万元以上 20 万元以下。还要对主要负责人罚 2 万元以上 5 万元以下（全国）
- 证据等级：A
- 来源：国务院 (2012). 对外劳务合作管理条例（国务院令第 620 号，第五、七、八、九、十、十一、十二、十三、二十一、二十三、二十五、二十六、二十九、三十一、三十七、三十九、四十、四十三条）. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2012-06/11/content_1091.htm>
- 备注：合规的流程是这样：公司先和国外雇主签书面劳务合作合同，再和你签书面服务合同或者劳动合同。合同要写明工作内容、期限、报酬、工时、休假、社保和人身安全风险。签完 10 个工作日内，公司要报商务主管部门备案。公司还必须安排你接受技能、安全防范、外语和当地法律风俗的培训，并给你买境外工作期间的人身意外伤害保险。对方不让看合同、要押金、催你先走后补手续，就是要避开的那种公司。境外高薪招聘骗局和电诈园区见第 21 节第 5 条，出发前要查的安全提醒和 12308 在第 21 节，不重复。条例没给出去干活的人设学历或年龄门槛，门槛在公司的资质上，也在干活所在国给不给许可上。公司只能跟那个国家批准过的企业或机构签合同，不能跟国外的个人签。备用金由主管部门在公司赖账时动用，你不能自己去取。所以真出事还得先向商务主管部门投诉，第二十条给了你这个投诉权。往同一个国家或地区派超过 100 人的，要安排随行的管理人员并报使领馆备案。人少的项目没有这层保障，更要自己留好合同和转账记录。

### 14. Before going abroad to work, check whether the company has a license for international labor cooperation: it is illegal for them to demand a deposit from you.
<!-- Cost Tag: Money=0 Time=Low Willpower=No Benefit=High Metric=Freedom -->

- Cost: No cost at all. Spend just a few minutes beforehand verifying the company’s credentials and reading through both contracts.

- In plain terms: When it comes to working overseas, the law regulates not the workers themselves but the companies that arrange their employment. Only businesses holding a valid license for international labor cooperation and properly registered may recruit workers for foreign jobs. Any claim such as “first obtain a tourist visa and later switch to a work visa” is a clear sign of illegal activity. Moreover, employers are strictly prohibited from charging any kind of deposit or demanding collateral from workers.

- Benefit: Article 5 of the Regulations on International Labor Cooperation states that companies must obtain approval from provincial or municipal commerce authorities before engaging in such activities; this approval results in a specific operating license. Article 7 mandates that the list of licensed firms be submitted to national authorities and shared with Chinese embassies and consulates abroad. Article 8 explicitly bans any entity from using business trips, tourism, or study abroad programs as a guise for labor export. Within five working days of registration, firms must deposit at least 3 million RMB into a designated fund intended to cover unpaid wages, service fees, and compensation for injuries or emergencies. This fund may also be tapped to repatriate workers in crisis situations. Articles 11, 12, and 13 forbid employment in gambling or adult entertainment venues, require mandatory pre-departure training, and mandate personal accident insurance coverage while abroad. Contracts must be signed separately with both foreign employers and workers; failure to do so renders any recruitment illegal. Article 25 reiterates the ban on deposits or property pledges. All agreements must be filed with commerce authorities within ten days, and companies must assist workers in securing compensation when contractual terms are violated. Article 31 allows authorities to halt recruitment to regions deemed unsafe, while Article 37 establishes a public registry of non-compliant firms. Unlicensed operators face severe penalties, including license revocation and criminal prosecution. Those misusing tourism or study visas for labor placement also incur heavy fines.

- Evidence grade: A
- Sources: State Council of China (2012). Regulations on the Administration of Foreign Labor Cooperation (State Council of China Order No. 620, Articles 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 21, 23, 25, 26, 29, 31, 37, 39, 40, 43). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2012-06/11/content_1091.htm>

- Notes: This entry outlines the lawful pathway for overseas employment. Legitimate procedures require the company to sign a labor cooperation agreement with a foreign employer, followed by a written service or employment contract with the worker detailing duties, pay, working hours, leave entitlements, social insurance, and safety measures. Within ten days, the firm must register these documents with authorities and provide language, safety, and cultural training. Personal accident insurance is mandatory. Red flags include refusal to show contracts, demands for deposits, or pressure to bypass proper paperwork. For information on high-paying overseas job scams and fraud hubs, see Section 21.5; safety advisories and contact details for the 12308 consular hotline are also listed there. The regulations impose no specific educational or age prerequisites on workers; eligibility hinges on both corporate licensing and host-country requirements. Contracts may only be concluded with approved foreign enterprises, never private individuals. The aforementioned financial reserve cannot be withdrawn by workers; it serves solely as a safety net for unpaid claims. Should problems arise, workers retain the right to file complaints with commerce authorities per Article 20. Projects sending more than 100 personnel to a single destination must also assign on-site supervisors and notify local embassies or consulates. Smaller groups lack such safeguards, so workers should retain all contracts and payment records as proof of their legal status.

title: 在家给境外公司远程干活，这笔钱在税法上算境内所得：个税自己报，收汇走「职工报酬」
englishTitle: Working remotely for a foreign company from home: this income is considered domestic earnings for tax purposes; you must file your own individual income tax returns, and incoming payments should be reported as “employee compensation”.
originalText:
### 15. 在家给境外公司远程干活，这笔钱在税法上算境内所得：个税自己报，收汇走「职工报酬」
<!-- 成本标签: 钱=0 时间=中 毅力=些 收益=中 口径=金钱 -->
- 成本：不花钱。每年办一次汇算清缴，时间是次年 3 月 1 日到 6 月 30 日。收汇超过年度总额的时候，还要准备一份雇佣合同和收入证明。难在这笔税得你自己记着去报。
- 说人话：这笔钱算境内还是境外，看的是你在哪儿干活，不是钱从哪儿打进来。人在国内远程给境外公司干活，算境内所得，要在境内交个税。境外公司在中国没有机构，没人替你代扣，这笔税得你自己去报。钱汇进来走「职工报酬」这条路。
- 收益：这笔钱算不算境内所得，看《个人所得税法实施条例》（国务院令第 707 号，2019 年 1 月 1 日起施行）第三条。它写着：「除国务院财政、税务主管部门另有规定外，下列所得，不论支付地点是否在中国境内，均为来源于中国境内的所得：（一）因任职、受雇、履约等在中国境内提供劳务取得的所得」。同一部条例第六条给两个税目下了定义。一个是工资薪金：「工资、薪金所得，是指个人因任职或者受雇取得的工资、薪金、奖金、年终加薪、劳动分红、津贴、补贴以及与任职或者受雇有关的其他所得」。另一个是劳务报酬：「劳务报酬所得，是指个人从事劳务取得的所得，包括从事设计、装潢、安装、制图、化验、测试、医疗、法律、会计、咨询、讲学、翻译、审稿、书画、雕刻、影视、录音、录像、演出、表演、广告、展览、技术服务、介绍服务、经纪服务、代办服务以及其他劳务取得的所得」。《个人所得税法》第六条写怎么算应纳税所得额：「居民个人的综合所得，以每一纳税年度的收入额减除费用六万元以及专项扣除、专项附加扣除和依法确定的其他扣除后的余额，为应纳税所得额」。同一条还写着「劳务报酬所得、稿酬所得、特许权使用费所得以收入减除百分之二十的费用后的余额为收入额」。减 20% 这一句只列了这三项，工资薪金不在其内。所以工资薪金按全额计入收入额，两个税目算出来的税不同。第九条：「个人所得税以所得人为纳税人，以支付所得的单位或者个人为扣缴义务人」。第十条：「有下列情形之一的，纳税人应当依法办理纳税申报：……（二）取得应税所得没有扣缴义务人；……（四）取得境外所得」。第十一条：「居民个人取得综合所得，按年计算个人所得税……需要办理汇算清缴的，应当在取得所得的次年三月一日至六月三十日内办理汇算清缴」。钱汇进来看《个人外汇管理办法》（中国人民银行令〔2006〕第 3 号，2007 年 2 月 1 日起施行）。第九条：「对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额内的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；超过年度总额的，经常项目项下凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明等材料在银行办理」。第七条：「银行和个人在办理个人外汇业务时，应当遵守本办法的相关规定，不得以分拆等方式逃避限额监管，也不得使用虚假商业单据或者凭证逃避真实性管理」。《个人外汇管理办法实施细则》（汇发〔2007〕1 号）第二条：「对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值 5 万美元」。第十条：「境内个人经常项目项下非经营性结汇超过年度总额的，凭本人有效身份证件及以下证明材料在银行办理：……（七）职工报酬：雇佣合同及收入证明」（全国）
